root_cause.text: Using devm_request_threaded_irq() to register IRQs during the ASoC component probe causes those IRQs to outlive the sound card or component tear-down, allowing IRQ handlers to access freed card and kcontrol references after the card is removed.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "IRQs are enabled through sdca_irq_populate() from component probe using devm_request_threaded_irq(), this however means the IRQs can persist if the sound card is torn down. Some of the IRQ handlers store references to the card and the kcontrols which can then fail." The patch replaces devm_request_threaded_irq with request_threaded_irq and adds a component remove callback (class_function_component_remove) that calls sdca_irq_cleanup to manually free the IRQs and allocated names, ensuring they are released when the component is removed.
